theme_and_identity.mode: Hybrid (Light for Dashboard, Dark/Rich Navy for Landing Page Hero)
theme_and_identity.description: A professional, medical-grade CPR training and certification platform. Built to inspire trust, urgency, and community action. Avoid generic tech-startup vibes.

landing_page.hero: Left-aligned, dark navy background (bg-[#0B1B3D]) with bold white Playfair Display text. Red CTA button. Subtle grain texture or noise overlay. NOT centered.
landing_page.counter_section: Bento grid mode. High contrast metric cards showing '100K Mission Goal' vs 'Current Trained'.
landing_page.how_it_works: Staggered grid, generous spacing (p-12 to p-24).

dashboard.structure: F-pattern. Collapsible left sidebar (Navy background). Top header (White). Content area (Light Gray #F8FAFC).
dashboard.metrics_cards: Top row. 4 cards. Pure white surface, 1px subtle border, no heavy shadow. North Star metric (Total Trained) top left.
dashboard.charts: Recharts. Avoid pie charts (except for Category donut). Use District-wise Bar chart.
dashboard.data_tables: Flat solid surfaces. Crisp borders. Dense padding (p-4) for scanability.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Background: Emergency Red (#E63946). Text: White. Hover: Lighter red, subtle translateY(-1px).
buttons.secondary: Outline button. Border: Certificate Gold or Navy. Text: Navy.

cards.dashboard: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg. Hover: shadow-md.
cards.landing: Dark cards: bg-[#1A2B56] border border-white/10 text-white.

forms.inputs: Shadcn UI based. Solid white background. 1px border. Focus state: ring-2 ring-navy-light. NOT native inputs.

certificate.layout: Deep navy blue background. Gold/Red accents. KFR shield logo. Left side vertical text 'BE A HERO. SAVE A LIFE.' Bottom banner with taglines.
certificate.typography: Playfair Display for names and titles. Outfit for smaller details.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons and cards. Focus rings on inputs.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and landing page sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over navy background is pure white or high-contrast gold. APCA compliance required.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings (Navy or Gold) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="register-submit-btn"`).

media.icons: lucide-react. Use Shield, Heart, Activity, Stethoscope for medical/heroic vibes.

images.description: Man practices CPR on a training dummy outdoors. Good for landing page 'Training' section.
White and blue ambulance van. Good for heroic/emergency context.
Golden medallion with intricate designs. Use as the gold seal in the certificate.
Modern hospital building. Good for Aster Medcity context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using standard Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components in .js files (no .tsx).
For the Landing Page, use raw HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts (bento grids, asymmetric alignments).
For the Dashboard, use Shadcn components extensively (Cards, Tables, Dialogs, Select).
Use 'Recharts' for the admin dashboard (Bar chart for districts, Donut for categories).
The MCQ test should be a clean, distraction-free interface.
Implement the Certificate PDF as a highly styled HTML component that can be printed/exported, strictly adhering to the Navy/Gold/Red color scheme.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds in dropdowns, headers, or overlays.
Implement Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Outfit) in index.css.
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Add transitions for specific interactive elements (button, input) excluding transforms. DO NOT apply universal transition (all).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Always explicitly set text color on hover.
DO NOT use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡�🎯) for icons.
